```yaml
name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'challenges/**'
      - 'scripts/**'

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  python-lint:
    name: Python Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black isort flake8
      - name: Run black
        run: black --check .
      - name: Run isort
        run: isort --check-only .
      - name: Run flake8
        run: flake8 .

  cpp-lint:
    name: C++/CUDA Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install clang-format
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y clang-format
      - name: Check formatting
        run: |
          find . -regex '.*\.\(cpp\|hpp\|cu\|cuh\|c\)' -print0 | \
          xargs -0 clang-format -style=file -n

  mojo-lint:
    name: Mojo Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Basic Mojo validation
        run: |
          set -e
          found=0
          for f in $(git ls-files '*.mojo'); do
            echo "Checking $f"
            if ! grep -q '^import' "$f" && ! grep -q '@export' "$f"; then
              echo "❌ File $f missing import or @export"
              found=1
            fi
          done
          if [ $found -ne 0 ]; then
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "✅ All Mojo files validated"
```
